snippet.title: Riven | Official Launch Trailer | 4k
snippet.description:
Riven: remade from the ground up, 27 years later. Available NOW.

Buy Riven now:
Steam | https://store.steampowered.com/app/1712350/Riven
GOG | https://gog.com/en/game/riven
Meta Quest | https://vr.meta.me/s/1THYGRhu7zLdEXP
Mac App Store | https://apps.apple.com/us/app/riven/id1437437535

Travel to Riven, a beautiful and mysterious world on the verge of collapse. Explore this mysterious place, solve its puzzles, reveal its mysteries, make a daring rescue, and escape.

Learn more at: https://cyan.com/games/riven/
